description: This file contains the implementation of a SimpleGrain class in C#, which is part of an Orleans-based project. The class allows setting two integer values and provides methods to retrieve their product, as well as to modify the values. It includes lifecycle methods like OnActivateAsync and OnDeactivateAsync for grain activation and deactivation, and uses dependency injection of a logger.

classes.name: SimpleGrain
classes.description: A simple Orleans grain that manages two integers and provides multiplication methods, with logging and lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles actions upon grain activation, logs activation.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of A by 1.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of A and B.

methods.name: GetAxB (overload)
methods.description: Returns the product of provided arguments a and b.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Returns the current value of A.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles actions upon grain deactivation, logs deactivation.
